signature.name: VTask.map
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> [CommRing R] -> (I : Ideal R) -> {M : Type u_2} -> [AddCommGroup M] -> [Module R M] -> {N : Type u_3} -> [AddCommGroup N] -> [Module R N] -> (f : M →ₗ[R] N) -> AdicCompletion.AdicCauchySequence I M →ₗ[R] AdicCompletion.AdicCauchySequence I N

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is total and well-defined for all ideals I and all R-linear maps f; no junk-value or boundary conventions are needed.

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M N : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (a b : AdicCompletion.AdicCauchySequence I M), VTask.map I f (a + b) = VTask.map I f a + VTask.map I f b

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M N : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (r : R) (a : AdicCompletion.AdicCauchySequence I M), VTask.map I f (r • a) = r • VTask.map I f a

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M N : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N), VTask.map I f 0 = 0

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Nontrivial (AdicCompletion.AdicCauchySequence I M)], VTask.map I (0 : M →ₗ[R] M) ≠ LinearMap.id

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M N : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (a : AdicCompletion.AdicCauchySequence I M), VTask.map I f (-a) = -(VTask.map I f a)

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M N : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (a b : AdicCompletion.AdicCauchySequence I M), VTask.map I f (a - b) = VTask.map I f a - VTask.map I f b
